info.name: Nextdoor - Spring Bloom | Pastel Garden Glass
info.description:
Requires Nextdoor webpage settings to be set to Dark Mode. 

Bring the freshness of spring to Nextdoor with Spring Bloom — Pastel Garden Glass.

Deep forest-green surfaces, soft mint and lime accents, and cherry-blossom pink highlights create a lush seasonal atmosphere. Translucent glass panels and gentle blur allow a sunlit, flower-filled bokeh background to shine through.

The theme brings coordinated green-and-pastel styling to navigation menus, news feeds, Local Faves, marketplace listings, notifications, and Chats while preserving Nextdoor's familiar layout and functionality.
